steps.en: Drops in the /council coordinator plus 18 persona agents
steps.zh: 装入 /council 协调器与 18 个 persona agent

steps.en: Convene it on one genuinely hard decision
steps.zh: 拿一个真正难的决定召集它
steps.code: /council --triad strategy Where is our defensible advantage?

steps.en: Selects the panel and locks the 1.5x domain-weight seat before any analysis
steps.zh: 选定面板，并在任何人发言前锁定 1.5 倍领域加权席

steps.en: Round 1: every member restates the problem first, surfacing a framing clash to you
steps.zh: 第 1 轮：每位成员先复述问题，框架冲突会浮给你看

steps.en: Round 2: relays peer positions anonymized, and each member must defend or name the flaw
steps.zh: 第 2 轮：匿名转发同伴立场，每人必须辩护或点出自己论证的缺陷

steps.en: Tallies each final STANCE line at confidence weight against a 2/3 bar
steps.zh: 按置信度给每条最终 STANCE 计权，对 2/3 门槛计票

steps.en: A separate chairman writes the verdict: unresolved questions, kill criteria, one next step
steps.zh: 由独立的 chairman 写出裁决：未解问题、失效条件、一个具体下一步

value.en: You get an auditable verdict that keeps dissent and unresolved questions, instead of one model's confident answer
value.zh: 你拿到的是一份保留异议与未解问题、可审计的裁决，而不是某个模型自信的一段话
